name: BDCCL National Data Centre / 4TDC
developer: Bangladesh Data Center Company Limited (BDCCL), state-owned
notes: State-owned national data centre at Bangabandhu Hi-Tech City, Kaliakair, Gazipur (Dhaka division); runs national systems (e-governance, e-filing, health/social services, NID). Established 2019, described as largest in Bangladesh with Tier IV marketing claims (Grade B for capacity claims: ~200,000 sq ft, generators, cost figures per DCD/Dhaka Tribune). DCD reports BDCCL equipped its data centers with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure in 2024.

name: Meghna Cloud (BDCCL/Gennext JV)
notes: Bangladesh first cloud data centre, launched February 2024 at the BDCCL National Data Centre, Bangabandhu Hi-Tech City, Kaliakoir, Gazipur (Dhaka division). Official service pages (A); launch timing and JV history Grade B (DCD/Dhaka Tribune/Financial Express). Sovereign/state cloud anchor.

name: BCC National Data Center (NDC)
notes: Government NDC at ICT Tower, Agargaon, Dhaka; service documents describe cloud, VPS, load balancer, managed database, email and colocation/framework services for public bodies. Existence/ownership/location Grade A (official pages); tier/capacity claims require independent support.

name: Felicity IDC Limited
notes: Official operator page (checked 2026-08-12): Tier III Uptime-certified carrier-neutral data centre at Solaris (South Wing), Block-3, Kaliakair Hi-Tech Park (KHTP), Kaliakoir, Gazipur (Dhaka division); claims 100,000+ sq ft, 500+ racks, 5 MW power, N+N redundancy, ISO 9001/14001/27001, CRISL A rating. MW/rack figures are operator marketing (B as engineering fact); Uptime Institute client page confirms certification.

name: Fiber@Home colocation
notes: Operator page (checked 2026-08-12) confirms colocation services (including for ANS operators via its Central Offices) from major NTTN/ISP; journey page claims largest commercial colocation data centre (2024). Dhaka-division service; facility/address granularity needs per-site confirmation.

name: DhakaColo Dhaka (DHAKACOLO)
notes: Operator page (checked via search; direct fetch intermittently unavailable) confirms DhakaColo Tier-3 standard carrier-neutral colocation/cloud services in Dhaka on prime fiber routes. Multi-city operator claims (Chattogram, Jashore) recorded separately; per-site physical addresses grade C until individually verified.

name: CoLoCity Limited
notes: Operator page (checked 2026-08-12) confirms Tier III-standard carrier-neutral colocation at Mohakhali Tower, 82 Mohakhali C/A, Dhaka, operating since 2010 (claimed first commercial DC in Bangladesh; Tier III standard, not certified). Historical first/Tier claims Grade B/C.

name: Yotta Dhaka Data Center Park
notes: Announced 2023: ~$190m hyperscale data center park at Bangabandhu Hi-Tech City, Kaliakair (Gazipur, Dhaka division) with two buildings, 4,800 racks and 28.8 MW IT power; first phase originally targeted Q3 FY2024. No construction/operation evidence found in Aug 2026 checks; capacity figures are announced (B/C), status planned.

name: DataVolt Bangladesh data centre
notes: Announced 2023: $100m investment for a data centre on ~3 acres at Bangabandhu Hi-Tech City (Dhaka division), reported by DCD and W.Media. No construction or operation evidence as of Aug 2026; status announced.

name: Summit Group data centre
notes: The Business Standard (Jan 2026): Summit Group plans Bangladesh first purpose-built data centre near Dhaka leveraging the group gas/power/fiber assets, amid power-reliability challenges. Plan/announcement only; no physical facility record, tender or construction evidence.

name: ColoAsia Dhaka (lead)
notes: Operator site confirms ColoAsia exists and claims multiple data centres across Bangladesh including Dhaka; individual Dhaka physical site/address unverified (claims vary). Recorded as lead pending per-site verification; the Jashore (Khulna) site is separately evidenced via TIA-942.

name: BTCL/ADB Green Digital Data Centre
developer: Bangladesh Telecommunications Company Limited (BTCL) / ADB / PPP Authority
notes: DCD (27 Jan 2025): ADB signed MoU with Bangladeshi government for the country first green data centre on a BTCL-owned site near Chattogram, PPP model, renewable-powered, offering colocation to public/private enterprises plus BTCL internal storage. Transaction advisory agreement pending; no construction/operation evidence as of Aug 2026 - status planned.

name: DhakaColo Chattogram (IIUC Tower)
developer: Dhaka Colo Limited (via Chittagong Online Limited)
notes: Directory evidence (Datacenters.com/DatacenterMap) lists DhakaColo site at Chittagong Online Limited, IIUC Tower, Sk Sheikh Mujib Road, Chattogram; operator claims multi-city service (A for claim, C for physical site until operator primary page confirms). Cox's Bazar SMW-4 submarine cable landing (since 2005) is adjacent cable infrastructure, not counted as a datacenter.

name: ColoAsia Chattogram/Agrabad (lead)
notes: Aggregator/operator leads name ColoAsia/NRB Agrabad presence in Chattogram; no operator primary page or registry confirmation located for a physical Chattogram site. BDIX launched its 2nd Internet Exchange in Chattogram (bdix.net) - IXP infrastructure, not a datacenter. Lead only.

name: ColoAsia Jashore
notes: TIA Online registry (official TIA-942 certification directory) lists ColoAsia Limited, Jashore at Rashid Center, 7/A, Rabindranath Road, Jashore, Khulna division with signed TIA-942 certificate (TIA942BD251209001, valid to 2028); operator site confirms service. Address/certification existence Grade A; capacity/racks not disclosed.

name: BengalCloud Khulna/Jashore
notes: Operator page claims carrier-neutral datacenter network in Dhaka, Khulna and Jashore with 2N power, FM-200 suppression, 10Gbps BDIX; Khulna/Jashore sites listed with BDBL Bhaban/KDA-area references. Operator claim (A for what operator says) but site independence and underlying host unverified - graded C for facility evidence. Jashore Software Technology Park provides park context.

name: DhakaColo Jashore (lead)
notes: colocation.bd and DhakaColo claim a Jessore/Jashore location among DhakaColo multiple locations; no operator primary page with physical address located. Lead only.

name: Rajshahi COLO
notes: Operator site (checked via search snippet; site is JS-heavy) presents Rajshahi first commercial colocation facility provider with Tier III claims, BDIX VPS, dedicated servers and colocation in Rajshahi city; LinkedIn corroborates. Service existence Grade A/B per operator claim; Tier/date/address claims unverified independently - Grade B overall.

name: Grameenphone Super Core Data Center
notes: GP official press release + trade press: Super Core Data Center inaugurated in Sylhet on 30 Jan 2024, construction started Jan 2023 (GP+ZTE), 4 MW IT capacity, Tier III standard (not Uptime-listed per DCD), largest among MNOs in Bangladesh; modular/container-based with NOVEC fire suppression. 4 MW figure from GP announcement (A for official claim).

English and Bengali negative sweeps ('Rangpur Bangladesh data center/datacenter/colocation/server room', 'রংপুর ডেটা সেন্টার') plus operator/official searches (Colocloud Rangpur claim, BHTPA/STP records) found no named physical datacenter facility or project in Rangpur division. Only generic directory geography and unrelated hosting-marketing pages appear.

English and Bengali negative sweeps ('Mymensingh data center/datacenter/colocation/server room', 'ময়মনসিংহ ডেটা সেন্টার') plus operator/official searches found no named commercial datacenter facility in Mymensingh division (Mymensingh city, Jamalpur, Netrokona, Sherpur). Generic provider-map/directory pages for Mymensingh are not evidence of a facility.

English and Bengali negative sweeps ('Barishal data center', 'বরিশাল ডেটা সেন্টার', Kuakata data center/IDC/colocation) found no commercial datacenter in Barishal division. The Kuakata (Patuakhali) SEA-ME-WE 5 submarine cable landing station (operational since 2017, BSCCL) is telecom infrastructure, not a datacenter; no BSCCL/BTCL/ISP colocation or server-hosting evidence at the landing station was found.
